description: This file defines an interface for building JSON objects, allowing setting and removing fields with various data types and predicates. It is part of a JSON processing library within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a new integer value field to the JSON object, optionally conditioned on a predicate.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a new long value field to the JSON object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a new double value field to the JSON object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a new boolean value field to the JSON object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a new string value field to the JSON object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a new JsonValue field to the JSON object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field based on a JsonFieldDefinition and value, conditioned on a predicate.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field based on a JsonFieldDefinition and value.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JsonField directly with an optional predicate.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple fields with filtering predicate.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple fields without filtering predicate.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the JsonObject with the accumulated fields.
